I would love to tip a jar of moonshine back with someone like you actually. I have some advice for your bunker... I have a LOT of experience in that department since I am a paranoid half homeless vet living in the woods...

Hot water is hard in bad conditions. Have a few systems to make it if you are off the grid. Don't even THINK of living without hot water in bad conditions. It is number one... even before clean water TBH. You can always boil a pan of water from a fucking mud puddle if you have to but a hot shower is a gift from god. The following tools are excellent low-effort ways to make hot water:

A small solar panel, 200 feet of black irrigation hose, a small circulation pump from a fountain, a 50 gallon plastic barrel... preferably elevated above your head. Fill the barrel from your water source, lay the hose in a sunny area, turn on the circulation pump when the sun comes up (the right panel/pump combo will do this automatically) and turn it off about an hour after the sun reaches zenith. Open the valve on that barrel and glorious hot water will spew forth... Only on hot sunny days. For the winter build a rocket stove with a smaller heat loop in the chimney. Costs maybe $50 and some work. Make sure that copper loop will drain in case of frost because if that motherfucker freezes you are fucked... Happened to me last winter and that sucked. It got pretty stinkey before I got it rebuilt.

Get a heavy steel griddle and propane burner to fit that motherfucker. A few sheckles at Cabellas. ALWAYS have a few spare hoses for your propane system because that shit is made in mexico and will probably only last a year. In a grid-down situation you are totally fucked without a propane hose/regulator.

Even a small 12v solar system and some LED lights is a MASSIVE improvement over no power at all or a generator. Try hard to stay off the propane bottle as much as possible. Same with a generator. You are talking about the deep south... Good country. Set up rain water collection for drinking water. Don't give me the speech about a fucking well... Most wells have 240v pumps. Rain water collection, 2000 gallon elevated tank. Some chlorine tabs to keep it from going bad and you will have 2 years of drinking water on hand at all times.
